title: OpenJoystickDriver settings
description: The file Settings.json in the user's OpenJoystickDriver Application Support folder, which 'ojd setting set' and the app write. Every setting is optional; a setting the file leaves out takes its built-in default. The layers, lowest to highest: built-in defaults, the user file.

launchAtLoginOptOut.description: Internal state, not a setting: true after the user turned launch at login off through the app or 'ojd setting', so the app does not register itself automatically on its next start. Default false. The public key launchAtLogin is read from and written to the macOS login item (SMAppService), which stays the source of truth; a change made in System Settings does not update this field.

showInMenuBar.description: Show the OpenJoystickDriver item in the menu bar. Default true.

showInDock.description: Always show the OpenJoystickDriver icon in the Dock; when false it shows only while a window is open. Default false. Show in menu bar and Show in Dock cannot both be false.

controllerConnected.description: A controller connects or needs attention. Default false.

profileActivated.description: A profile becomes active. Default false.

profileDeactivated.description: The active profile is turned off. Default false.

sounds.description: A notification plays a sound. Default true.

checkAutomatically.description: Check for updates when the app starts. Default false.

includePrereleases.description: Include pre-release versions when checking for updates. Default false.

developerTools.description: Show the developer tools in the Settings window. Default false.
